description.de: Ihr Schicksal bringt sie in den kaiserlichen Palast, wo sie als Sklavin gnadenloser Gewalt ausgesetzt ist. Wie durch Zufall wird sie zur Konkubine des jungen Kaisers. Neid und Machtkämpfe stehen im Harem an der Tagesordnung. Doch sie wird alles dafür geben, um ihr Geheimnis zu wahren und ihre Mission zu erfüllen.
description.en:
Lingzhi is the long-lost princess of the Spirit Clan, known and feared for their prophetic abilities. To find her missing people, she must climb the social ladder in the human empire, while many resent her rapid rise to power. Her efforts have caught the attention of the mercurial emperor, who is controlled by the empress dowager, as well as a mysterious silver-haired man who haunts Lingzhi’s dreams. Can she learn (and thwart) their cutthroat ways so that she may claim her rightful throne?

---
What price must be paid in order to achieve absolute power? Is it perhaps being misunderstood and rejected by others, being labeled as a witch, or killing a beloved one? Orphan Ling of Zu has the ability to predict the future, learns to survive the palace intrigue and becomes Queen Ling.

---
What is the price to pay for supreme power? Being misunderstood by the world? Carrying the stigma of being a "demon girl"? Killing one's most beloved people? Watch as an orphaned girl of the Spirit people with the ability to predict the future learns to plot in the Imperial Palace, is reborn from her ashes and becomes the Peoples' Empress of the Generation.

---

description.es: Ling Zhi, la única superviviente del clan de los espíritus, hará todo lo necesario para llegar a la cima del poder y descubrir su pasado.
description.es-la: Ling Zhi, la única sobreviviente del clan de los espíritus, hará todo lo necesario para llegar a la cima del poder y descubrir su pasado.
description.fr:
Quel prix faut-il payer pour obtenir un pouvoir absolu?  
Faut-il être mal comprise et rejetée par les autres, être étiquetée comme une sorcière, ou tuer la personne aimée?  
L'orpheline Lin de Zu a la capacité de prédire l'avenir.  
Elle va apprendre à survivre dans le palais et devenir la Reine Ling.
description.it:
Che prezzo dovrà pagare Ling Zhi per conquistare il potere assoluto?
E riuscirà a sopravvivere a tutte le avversità del palazzo imperiale?
